purpose: This directory contains a STALE rules file. This pointer says which file is authoritative so no reader or tool resolves the wrong one by directory.

authoritative_rules_file.why_those_two: they are the two copies the frozen harness itself reads and reports as rules_file_sha256; both were committed by the pre-measurement freeze commits 2770b1520 / 34cd92806 / ff5933f1e (2026-10-18T21:21:56Z .. 21:25:57Z)

its de-kapitalverletzung pin is 2441ff2b16722afcd22dca9ad39eafcbeb079b2dfc367d763fbe53fce1356f9c while the accepted bundle re-hashes to c4005d4b78553b0aebd92bba59001c87a376146873f807d575255a4f721dd7f2
it predates freeze amendments A1 and A2, so it does not carry the accepted coverage definition or the generator well-formedness amendment
stale_rules_file_in_this_directory.disposition: left byte-untouched as the historical record of run 39157032880; AGENTS.md forbids deleting contrary or historical outputs. It is NOT read by any entry point shipped by this team.

how_to_resolve_pins_correctly: frontier/frontier-query-concept-recall/cli_entry.py::rules_bundle_pins reads the canonical file and re-hashes BOTH canonical copies against the pinned digest c5447bac... before it uses any pin, and re-hashes every pinned bundle against its pin. A moved freeze or a moved bundle aborts with exit 2 and no measurement is written.
verification: frontier/frontier-query-concept-recall/verify.py check R1_canonical_rules_copies_identical recomputes all of this from the tree on every run.
claim_ceiling: This pointer concerns file identity and digest reproduction only. It makes no claim about any threshold, bar, gate, packet or the charter outcome.
